display.title: Episode 365: The Return of Yehudah, Chapter 10 (Parshas Ki Sisa)
display.summary_short: The secret of Shabbos hidden in the opening words of Ki Sisa, two Shema guests, and the old man's parting gift to Yehudah: a talis katan with a secret message sewn inside.
display.summary_long: Broadcast in the week of Parshas Ki Sisa 5749. Uncle Yossi explains 'Baruch Hashem, here we are': every day is a chance to go higher in holiness. The parsha opens with counting the Jewish people by the half-shekel, but hidden in the words 'when you lift up the head' is a secret: raise each letter of rosh (reish, aleph, shin) one step in the aleph-beis and you get Shabbos. Shabbos is the head of the Jewish people, and the Sages say that keeping two Shabbosos would bring the redemption, so the order of the week is to learn the laws of Shabbos. After the Hakochainik march, the old man examines Yehudah's tzitzis and promises him a special new talis katan. Two fifth-grade girls from Beis Yaakov of Boro Park lead the Shema. Then the old man explains that a secret message sewn into the talis katan, to be opened only under the chuppah, will reveal where his parents are, and gives him a sign for the town where he should settle. Yehudah bids the hidden tzaddik farewell. The show ends with the Simcha Club and Shabbos times.
display.lesson: Lift up Shabbos and you lift up the whole Jewish people: learn the laws of Shabbos every week.
